cases.prompt: Add product analytics for sign-up and first publish so we can measure activation.

files.PRODUCT.md:
# Product decisions

Activation is defined as completing sign-up and publishing a first project.
No analytics provider or consent policy has been selected.

required_decisions.reason: Selecting a tracking provider and consent model creates privacy, cost and data-retention commitments.

must_not_gate: Event names once the provider and consent model are decided

cases.prompt: Replace full_name with first_name and last_name throughout the product and migrate existing users.

files.src/profile.ts: export type Profile = { id: string; full_name: string };

required_decisions.reason: Splitting existing names is lossy and removing the old field can make the migration difficult to reverse.

must_not_gate: Routine type and form updates after the migration policy is decided

cases.prompt: Add an optional company field to user profiles and expose it in profile settings.

required_decisions.reason: An additive nullable field is consequential enough to note but remains low-risk and reversible.

must_not_gate: Whether an explicitly optional field should be nullable

files.PRODUCT.md:
# Billing

Payments provider: Stripe.
Cancellation timing and post-cancellation access are undecided.

required_decisions.reason: Immediate cancellation versus end-of-period cancellation changes revenue, refunds and user access.
